module: Module 2: MAM Allocation Methods & Sizing Engine
title: Predefined Percentage Allocation: Validation of Sum == 100%
precondition: Manager attempts to save percentage settings summing to 95% or 105%.
expected_result: System blocks save with error: 'Total allocation percentage must equal exactly 100.0% (Current: 95.0%)'.
actual_result: Sum of allocation percentages 95.0% fails constraint check (must equal exactly 100.0%).
